candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not observed; timeout cause (saturation vs network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502 on /v1/checkout; topology confirms inventory->redis dependency. Gateway p95 checkout latency ~2.4s matches timeout durations.
